gallery_binding_scope: Root integrates these verified runtime image files after this proof; this review does not assert final reader-route binding.

reporting_review.corrigendum_scope: Micrometastatic deposits >0.2–2 mm and/or >200 cells; isolated tumour cells ≤0.2 mm and ≤200 cells. These are pathological definitions, not MRI size classifications.
reporting_review.primary_IV_categories: IVA bladder/bowel mucosa; IVB extrapelvic abdominal peritoneum; IVC other distant sites including nodes above renal vessels.
reporting_review.molecular_notation_scope: POLEmut/p53abn can change I/II categories; known III/IV molecular class can be recorded with m without changing anatomical category.

corrections_verified.change: Early category modification versus advanced molecular notation distinguished; original source glyph retained and unendorsed.
Unverified pelvic-only peritoneal label removed; original IVB and complete-distribution uncertainty retained.
Unsupported vaginal-cuff identity removed; local bladder/urethra and distinct MRI/PET observations retained.

known_source_errors_not_imported_as_curr.issue: IIB incorrectly described as myometrial invasion for any aggressiveness; primary IIB is substantial LVSI/nonaggressive and IIC is aggressive histology with myometrial invasion.
Absence of LVSI stated too broadly; primary IA3 criterion excludes substantial/extensive LVSI. Full clinicopathological eligibility cannot be inferred from paired uterus/ovary images.
Above-renal-vessel nodes labelled IVB; primary FIGO IVC is retained in runtime staging.
Unconventional original IIIB2POLEmut glyph retained without verifying or endorsing notation.

current_pubmed_notice_check.scope: Current record check on review date, not a future-notice guarantee.

independent_visual_review.scope: Whole image samples and annotations preserved. Original PDFs contain slight placement scaling; runtime preserves native sample aspect, not a page-layout clone or patient calibration.
